subject: ss-nephrology
title: Nutrition and conservative kidney management

steps.tx: Protein energy wasting (PEW) is a state of **loss of body protein and energy stores** seen in advanced CKD. It reflects reduced intake, inflammation and metabolic stress together. Malnutrition in CKD predicts poor outcomes, so nutritional status must be assessed early and repeatedly. Two commonly used tools are **subjective global assessment (SGA)** and the **malnutrition inflammation score (MIS)**, which adds inflammatory and dialysis-specific markers to the clinical history.

steps.tx: In conservative management of advanced CKD, protein restriction is considered to slow decline, but it must never worsen wasting. Ketoanalogues are **essential amino acid analogues** given with a very low protein diet to supply nitrogen-free building blocks. They are an option for selected patients who cannot tolerate adequate protein intake. Energy intake should be maintained, as calorie deficit accelerates muscle loss.

steps.tx: Dietary management of **potassium** and **phosphorus** is central in CKD. Potassium restriction is needed when serum levels rise, while hyperphosphataemia is treated with diet and phosphate binders. Phosphorus is often hidden in processed foods as **phosphate additives**, which are absorbed far more completely than natural organic phosphate. Patients should be taught to read food labels for phosphate additives.
steps.say: Dietary management of potassium and phosphorus is central in kidney disease. Potassium restriction is needed when serum levels rise, while raised phosphate is treated with diet and phosphate binders. Phosphorus is often hidden in processed foods as phosphate additives, which are absorbed far more completely than natural phosphate. Patients should learn to read food labels for these additives.

steps.tx: Restless legs syndrome affects many people on dialysis, disrupting sleep and daily life. First line steps include **correcting iron deficiency** and **optimising dialysis adequacy**, with gabapentinoids used when symptoms persist. **Advance care planning** is an ongoing dialogue about values, goals and preferred treatment, recorded so future decisions honour the patient's wishes. Start it early rather than waiting until dialysis is withdrawn.

steps.tx: Conservative kidney management offers an alternative to dialysis and is chosen through a **shared decision** that weighs the patient's wishes and **comorbidity**. Serum **albumin** is a poor marker of nutrition because it reflects inflammation as much as intake. Distinguish **protein energy wasting** from simple dietary restriction, since the former carries a worse prognosis. Before finalising any conservative plan, record **nutritional status**, potassium, phosphate and symptom burden.
